data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 111.035m. During 2018 the syndicate experienced a net surplus run-off of GBP 3.5m (a release), comprised of a GBP 1.7m surplus on direct prior year claims provisions and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted prior year provisions, contributing to closing gross claims outstanding of GBP 87.928m at 31 December 2018. The movement is described as favourable claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 3.5m was experienced in 2018 (2017: GBP 18.1m surplus).

This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 1.7m on direct business (2017: GBP 22.5m surplus) and a GBP 1.8m surplus on reinsurance accepted business (2017: GBP 4.4m deficit).

The most uncertain element within these technical provisions is the amount for gross claims outstanding which covers amounts where either the claim has been notified to the syndicate or where there has not yet been a notification or although notified there has been insufficient information to date to be certain regarding its ultimate costs.
